Name: WSilenceW's Sunny Theme Furniture(FF)(AT)
Author: WSilenceW
Description:
新增一些清新风格的晴天主题的壁纸、地板和家具，需要FF3.0（Furniture Framework）及AT（Alternative Textures）作为前置。 

壁纸、地板和红砖壁炉需要AT前置，使用油漆桶道具更换纹理。 其余家具需要FF前置，通过晴天家具目录获取家具，目录在罗宾的商店购买，或者从游戏内原有的“家具目录”获取。

我的小红书账号：韭菜炖大鹅

=====================================================

The wallpaper, flooring, and red brick fireplace require AT (Alternative Textures) as a prerequisite. Use the paint bucket tool to change their textures. All other furniture require FF (Furniture Framework) as a prerequisite. Obtain them from the Sunny Theme Furniture Catalog, which can be purchased from Robin's shop or found in the vanilla Furniture Catalog.
